blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin “Win” Gatchalian declined to discuss the personal details of his breakup with former girlfriend Bianca Manalo, saying his commitment to public service has shaped the direction of his career. “I will no longer address the personal aspect. But I love my country, I love the Philippines, I love our nation,” Gatchalian said in Filipino on Monday, Oct. 19, when asked to respond to Manalo’s statement on the reason behind their separation. “When I entered public service, that really became the direction of my career.
